newsitem.title: UK: AEA Technology share offer range 240-270 p/shr.
newsitem.headline: AEA Technology share offer range 240-270 p/shr.

text.p: The indicated offer price for shares in AEA Technology being privatised by the UK government is between 240 and 270 pence per share, giving the group a market capitalisation of between 192 and 216 million stg, J. Henry Schroder & Co Ltd said on Tuesday.
Schroders said it was issuing the flotation prospectus for the science and engineering services business on behalf of the UK government.
AEA's will have a notional gross dividend yield of between 3.5 and 3.9 percent based on a notional net dividend of 7.5 pence per share for the year ended March 31 1996.

The closing date for applications for shares is September 24. The offer price and allocation of shares will be announced on September 25 and the shares are due to start trading on September 26. -- London Newsroom + 44 171 542 7717
